servinfo.title: Warning for Blind Spot Monitor System

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take the following precautions may cause a serious accident affected by malfunction of blind spot monitor system.

item.ptxt: Keep the rear bumper around the sensors clean always.
Do not drop or otherwise expose blind spot monitor control module to large shock. The blind spot monitor control module that has received large shock should be replaced.
If peripheral component of the rear bumper is damaged, check the blind spot monitor control module and its bracket.
When replacing rear bumper, use SUZUKI genuine parts.
Do not affix clear film or sticker etc. to rear bumper at the area of radar irradiation.
Do not apply paint to rear bumper at the area of radar irradiation.
If rear bumper is damaged, deformed, dented or cracked at the area of radar irradiation, replace the bumper.
